items.docs: Upload a single data chunk for a v2 transaction. Chunks must be uploaded after the transaction header is submitted via POST /tx. Maximum chunk size is 256 KiB. The data_root from the transaction must be registered (transaction submitted) before chunks can be uploaded.

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte offset of the chunk within the weave

items.docs: Download a data chunk at the specified weave byte offset. Returns the chunk data along with its offset and size metadata.
